_readme: This file is the published course. Everything students see comes from here.
Workflow: open the site with #studio on the end, build in the Content screen,
press Export JSON, bump 'version' by one, and replace this file in GitHub.
'id' on a test or deck must never change once students have used it - their
scores and card schedules are filed under it. Change the title freely; keep the id.
'ans' is the position of the correct option counting from 0, so 0 = first option.
Delete the four sample entries below once your own content is in.

questions.expl: Add 7 to both sides: 3x = 18. Divide by 3: x = 6.

questions.text: Which value of x satisfies x squared - 5x + 6 = 0?
questions.expl: The expression factors as (x - 2)(x - 3), so x = 2 or x = 3. Check: 2 + 3 = 5 and 2 x 3 = 6.

questions.text: A line passes through (0, 3) and (2, 7). What is its gradient?
questions.expl: Gradient = change in y over change in x = (7 - 3) / (2 - 0) = 4/2 = 2.

cards.b:
x = (-b +/- sqrt(b^2 - 4ac)) / 2a

For any equation of the form ax^2 + bx + c = 0, with a not equal to 0.

cards.f: Discriminant, and what it tells you
cards.b:
D = b^2 - 4ac

D > 0: two distinct real roots
D = 0: one repeated root
D < 0: no real roots

cards.f: Gradient of a straight line through two points
